slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: A configuration review is a structured assessment of how your technology is set up, across Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, servers, networks and business applications. We identify inconsistencies, outdated settings and security gaps, then give you prioritised, practical recommendations.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We review the systems that matter most to your business, typically Microsoft 365, Azure and other cloud services, user permissions and authentication, servers and workstations, and network infrastructure such as firewalls and wireless. The scope is tailored to how your organisation actually works.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Will a review disrupt our business?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: No. A configuration review is an assessment rather than a change to your live systems. We agree scope and timing in advance, and any recommended changes are discussed and planned with you before anything is adjusted.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: What do we get at the end?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: A clear report written in straightforward language, explaining what we found and why it matters, with recommendations prioritised by business impact. We can also help you put those improvements in place and introduce a documented standard for future changes.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Is a configuration review a one-off or ongoing?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Either. Many businesses start with a one-off review for reassurance, then move to regular reviews as technology and requirements change. Ongoing reviews help keep Microsoft 365 and cloud services securely configured and consistent as your business grows.
